correctness.rationale: Symbolic two-stage stability calculation gives R(z)=1/(1-z+z²/2). The transient Jordan block yields an exact sine coefficient sequence; summation gives absorption entry q^k[cos(kθ)+sin(kθ)] with θ=atan(1/(1+h)) and q=cosθ−sinθ. Necessary and sufficient angular threshold follows by first integer crossing 3π/4, with h=0 and n≤4 handled. Cotangent expansion gives large-n law. Direct rational inversion and coefficient recurrence passed 26022 finite assertion groups; analytic proof covers all dimensions.

value.rationale: Exact all-length all-step domain is a natural positivity condition for approximated Markov transitions; the unexpected five-state onset of small-step failure and sharp large-step recovery, with critical h_n~4n/(3π), are structural and not explained by generic A/L-stability. Explicit entries and unique critical nonstructural zero give practical diagnostics. Does not claim large steps are accurate.
